doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Integrated bands
summary: Bert says integration was never an issue for him in New York.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Was there ever any issues about integrated bands at the time?
No I always worked that way. It’s what you play. It has nothing to do with the other thing. So I never got into that.
